# Fastest Revenue Growth
The S&P 500's fastest top-line growers
Updated October 11, 2026
Revenue growth is the rawest sign of demand: are more customers paying a company more money than they did a year ago? This board ranks the S&P 500 by trailing-twelve-month sales growth against the prior year — the realized number, not an analyst’s hope. It’s where you find the businesses actually taking share right now.
Growth on its own isn’t a buy signal — the market often pays up for it in advance, and the fastest growers can be the most expensive stocks in the index. So each row pairs top-line growth with whether earnings are keeping pace: revenue that scales into profit is the kind worth owning; revenue that doesn’t is just motion.
